name: Advocate Graduate Stipend Gujarat
benefit: > **Stipend to junior tribal advocates:** - ₹10,000 per month for the first year. - ₹8,000 per month for the second year. - ₹6,000 per month for the third year. > **Allowance to senior advocate (mentor):** - ₹5,000 per month for three years.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a Scheduled Tribe (ST) youth. 1. The applicant should have completed LLB degree. 1. The applicant should have obtained a charter within two years of graduation. 1. The applicant should begin legal practice as a junior lawyer under a senior advocate. 1. The applicant should be practicing in tribal areas of Gujarat.
